与旅行一起成长(Growing up with travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:艾米的经历、感受与成长。
Amy thanked Mia for the honest advice. Mia advised Amy to try cooking as a new hobby. Amy ordered fish and tea at the ticket office last night. In fact, the open-top bus suits sunny days.

At first, Amy found it difficult to keep the habit. People around Amy often share different ideas about the travel plan. The travel plan looked quieter than usual that evening. A kind passenger helped me with my suitcase.
The ticket office has become an important part of daily life. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Little by little, things began to change. My luggage is too heavy to carry.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Mia always says that small steps matter more than big plans. The highway links the two cities.
The experience taught Amy more than any book could. Amy's dream job is to be a cook. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams.
